text: Caitlin's pregnant!! Due early March. Remind me to send her something the week after the baby arrives, not before, she's superstitious about it.
samir mum hip op fri at 3pm. he's taking her in. text him that evening
Yara said her brother Jonah is getting baptised, no wait, it's his little girl's christening, sometime next month at St Anne's. Her whole family's flying in from Lagos.
Adaeze and her husband Chris have booked Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. She wants a decent camera before they go, hint hint.
Fern struggling a bit. Baby's six weeks and not sleeping, her partner's back at work Monday. I should drop round some food tomorrow morning.
Salma - interview at the bank Thurs 9.30am. nervous. msg the night before
Note to self: dentist on the 12th at half 9, then pick up the dry cleaning.
Lila's dog Biscuit got out again last night, found him two streets over. She's shattered.
Lukas mentioned his dad turns 70 at the end of the month, big lunch planned. Lukas is doing the speech and is dreading it.
Shira had the twins!! Born Sunday at 4am, both fine, a boy and a girl. Names TBC. Don't forget to organise a card from everyone at work by Friday.

So Mustafa's sister Eva is moving to Manchester sometime next week for a new job, and his mum's not taking it well. Ask him how she's doing after the move. His dad isn't great either, still waiting on test results from the hospital, so Mustafa's basically holding the fort with two kids under five and a wife who works nights. He looked knackered.
Lola's baby shower is cancelled, she's on bed rest instead. Must check in with her at the weekend.
Ioana loves pottery, goes to a class on Tuesday evenings. Hates coriander.
bruno & heather - housewarming sat 7pm. I'm bringing the wine

Michael said his wife Magda is expecting again, due around the end of April. Their eldest, Bruno, is starting reception in September too so it's going to be a mad year for them. Magda's been having awful morning sickness this time round and is off work till the new year. Michael asked if we could have Bruno for a sleepover some weekend to give them a break, which I said yes to.
Need to ring Mai the day before her scan to see if she wants a lift. It's next Wednesday at 2.
Jasmine got into the choir!! Auditioned last week, she was so worried.
Ayesha's mum passed away on Saturday. Funeral is Thursday at 11. Remind me to send flowers the day before and text Ayesha that evening.
Lin Zhou, Ciara's new partner - works as a vet nurse, really into climbing. Seemed lovely.
Esme said Siobhan's christening for baby Rory is on the 3rd at 2pm, then lunch at the Crown. I'm godmother so I need to get a gift before then.

chat with Camila. her little one starts nursery tomorrow morning. she's more nervous than the kid lol. text her at lunch to see how drop off went. also she said her husband's back on nights from next week so she's basically solo with the baby and the toddler till christmas, offered to help with pickups thurs afternoons
Marisol back from Peru, trip was amazing. Brought me coffee beans.

Dmitri's daughter Amara has her driving test early next week, third attempt. He says she's a wreck about it. Remind me to message Dmitri the day after to find out. Apparently she failed the last one on a roundabout and cried the whole way home, and her instructor reckons it's nerves more than anything. Dmitri's paying for extra lessons Saturday mornings and his wife Siobhan has been taking her out in the evenings.
Caitlin's husband Samir got the promotion! Starts as team lead after Christmas.
Groceries, bin day moved to Tuesday, book the boiler service for sometime next week.
Yara's brother Mustafa is getting married in early June in Istanbul. She's asked if I'd come. Need to sort time off before the end of the month.
Ran into Heather at the school gate. Her son Jonah broke his wrist at football on Saturday, cast for six weeks. Poor thing's gutted, he's missing the cup final.

Adaeze told me tonight she's twelve weeks pregnant. First scan was this morning, all looks good. She hasn't told her parents yet, planning to on Sunday at her mum's birthday dinner. Her husband Chris is over the moon but she's feeling really sick most days and is exhausted. I should take her out for lunch sometime next week and remember she's off soft cheese and alcohol now.
Fern Osei — Fernie to everyone — new on the team, starts Monday. Lives in Leyton with her cat Pickle.
Michael's mum in hospital since Tuesday, chest infection. He's going up to see her Saturday morning. Call him Sunday evening.

voice memo... ok so Salma rang, she got the job, the bank one, starts on the first of next month, she's buzzing. Her boyfriend Lukas is taking her out Friday night to celebrate. Oh and she said her sister's due any day now, so it's all happening for them.
Ioana's birthday the 18th. She's been going on about a new yoga mat, the cork ones.
Not much to report, quick catch up with Lila over coffee. All good.
Bruno's wife Eva lost her job last week, redundancy. He's putting a brave face on it but they've just had the baby. Remind me to check in on them over the weekend.

Shira's son Dmitri graduates from Leeds on the 14th at 10am. She's so proud. Send her a congrats message that afternoon. He's got a job lined up in London starting in the autumn, something in finance, and his girlfriend Mai is moving down with him. Shira's pretending she's fine with it but I think she's going to miss him terribly.
Chris said the stag do is off, his brother Michael and Jasmine split up. Michael's in a bad way. Must ring him tomorrow evening.
Esme is vegan, allergic to nuts, and supports Arsenal. Keep in mind for the dinner.
Marisol's grandson was born yesterday morning! 8lb 2oz, called Mateo. Her daughter Camila is doing well. Need to get a little something before I see them end of next week.
Camila's partner Lin has a big presentation to the board Friday at 3pm. Camila says he's barely slept. Remind me to text him good luck Thursday night.
Heather Brennan and her husband are renewing their vows over the summer, 25 years. Small do in the garden. She wants everyone in yellow.
Pick up prescription. Gym 7am tomorrow. Mum's for lunch Sunday.
Ayesha's dad having his knee done early March. She's taking a fortnight off to help. Remember to ask how it went the week after.
siobhan pregnant, 20wk scan tues afternoon, finding out the sex. they've got names ready

Talked to Jasmine about her nan who's 90 on Saturday. Party at the community hall at 2pm, everyone bringing a dish. Jas is making her nan's famous jollof. Her uncle Bruno is flying in from Accra for it and she hasn't seen him in years. Also her mum asked if I could help set up the tables in the morning, so I'm going over at 11.
Lukas's little boy is in hospital with tonsillitis, should be home tomorrow. Lukas sounded exhausted. I should drop off some colouring books.
Mai and her girlfriend Ciara are moving in together at the end of the month. Flat in Peckham.
Remember Amara's son's christening is on the 21st at 11am. Find out if they want a card or cash beforehand, then send a photo to her mum afterwards.
Jonah's off to Japan for three weeks in early March. Wants recommendations for Kyoto.
Caitlin's sister Lola had a miscarriage last week. Caitlin's trying to hold everyone together. Don't push, just text Caitlin tomorrow and ask how she is.
Uncle Mustafa's 60th tomorrow evening at the Lebanese place. I'm driving Mum there at 6.

Long call with Magda. Her mum's been diagnosed with early dementia and they're looking at care homes sometime over the next few weeks. Magda's doing the visits on her own because her brother Samir lives in Dubai and can't get back until Christmas. She's not sleeping and she's really angry with him about it. I need to offer to go with her to one of the visits, maybe next Tuesday afternoon, and send her the number for that support group.
Eva Kim, Bruno's colleague. Mad about vinyl, collects old Motown records.
dmitri's cat Pushkin has his op thurs morning. text after
Samir and his wife Yara expecting their first in the summer. He's terrified, already reading all the books.
Ciara has her final piano exam Wednesday at half 2. She said she's fine but she isn't. Message her at lunchtime that day, and remind me to ask about results the week after.
Heather's eldest, Michael, has just started at Durham. She cries every time she mentions it. Ring her sometime next week.
Amara's grandad died at the weekend, funeral early next week. She's flying out to Ghana on Monday morning.
Lin's baby boy Theo turns one on the 9th. Party in the park at noon if it's dry. Need to get a present by the weekend before, she mentioned wooden stacking toys.

Saw Salma Usman at the shop. Her mum is due a hip replacement over the summer, and her brother Jonah has just had a baby girl, Iris, born last Tuesday. Christening already pencilled in for early spring. Salma's being godmother and is a bit anxious about the vows and the church bit since she's not religious. I should send Jonah a card this week and ask Salma about the christening date nearer the time.
Camila was nervous about her job review on Friday at 10. Text her that evening to ask how it went.
